UI journey is state-overlay isGameOver(game.board)->{gameOver ? <GameOverOverlay:null} sibling to frozen GameBoard not a route — E2E intentionally N/A same posture as 6.1/6.2/7.1/7.2. UI states: insets undefined/zero, isNewRecord true/false, reducedMotion true/false, CTA pointerEvents auto never none through 280ms fade all pinned.
